metadata.title: Everyday Mastery Seed: High-Demand Work Standards
metadata.notes: Essential certifications for high-demand work in the current economy.

nodes.title: CDL Class A: Theory Mapping
nodes.description: Fundamental knowledge for commercial driving. Vehicle inspections, air brakes, safe driving practices, and cargo handling.

nodes.title: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) Foundation
nodes.description: Patient care, safety, and infection control. Measuring vital signs and assisting with daily living activities. Linked to Bioregional Vitality.

nodes.title: NFPA 70E: Standard for Electrical Safety
nodes.description: Workplace safety standard for electrical workers. Arc flash hazards, shock protection, and safe work practices. Essential for Solar and Microgrid work.

nodes.title: Property Management Professional Basics
nodes.description: Lease management, maintenance coordination, and tenant relations. Understanding the legal rights and responsibilities of property stewardship.

nodes.title: Google Project Management Certificate
nodes.description: Foundations of project management: initiating, planning, and executing projects. Agile, Waterfall, and Lean methodologies. Practical skills for guild leaders.

edges.rationale: Water stewardship knowledge is critical for maintenance coordination in property management.
First-line emergency care provides the medical foundation for nursing assistant skills.
Electrical safety training requires a foundational understanding of circuits and physics.
